questions.q: How many usable host addresses does a /26 network have?
What is the network address of 172.16.5.77/24?
questions.explain: With /24 the last octet is the host part, so it becomes 0: 172.16.5.0.

questions.q: What is the broadcast address of 192.168.1.130/26?
questions.explain: The block size is 64. 130 falls in the block 128–191, and the broadcast address is the last address, 191.

questions.q: A /24 network is split into 4 equal subnets. What is the new prefix?
A PC shows the address 169.254.10.20. What does this usually mean?
options: It is a private address given by the router
The PC could not get an address from a DHCP server
questions.explain: When DHCP fails, the device gives itself an address from 169.254.0.0/16 (APIPA).
The block size is 16. 77 falls in the block 64–79, so the network is 192.168.1.64/28.
